name: Nexodev
description: The domain that owns ERP and CRM products, DevOps and cloud service delivery, and the infrastructure procedure of the platform.

acceptedAnswer.text: ERP and CRM products, DevOps practice and cloud services. Nexodev also owns the infrastructure procedure of the platform: clusters, hosts, secrets, images, observability and recovery.

mainEntity.name: Which toolchain does Nexodev operate with?

acceptedAnswer.text: The shared Underpost CLI. Nexodev documents its use for infrastructure work; the CLI itself belongs to the Underpost domain.
The Underpost CLI, the semantics of a product domain, and architecture decisions. Decisions are recorded as ADRs in the Underpost domain.

mainEntity.name: What state are these procedures in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Active development. The procedures are in use against real deployments.
